connections.note: Stud and anti-stud datums derived from LDCad Shadow Library snap metadata. This file is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

limitations: Only radius-6 stud and anti-stud connections join parts in the engine; bars, clips, pins and hinges are listed as other connectors (centre datum, axis, length) and used only by fixed recipes (window glass, doors, clip-hinged modules).
Bodies are convex hulls of each part without its studs; concave details are filled. Collision checks use the bounding box.
Nominal datums do not prove clutch force or stability.
